items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the tangent of a value that is measured in the given unit.
items.translation: 创建一个新 AggregationExpression，用于计算给定unit（单位）中值的正切。

items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the tangent of a value that is measured in ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AggregationExpression，用于计算以 ArithmeticOperators.AngularUnit.RADIANS 为单位的值的正切。

items.translation: 创建一个新的 AggregationExpression，用于计算给定弧度值的正切。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that calculates the tangent of a numeric value in the given unit.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AggregationExpression，用于计算给定 unit 中数值的正切值。

items.source: Creates a new AggregationExpression that calculates the tangent of a value that is measured in radians.
items.translation: 创建一个新 AggregationExpression，用于计算以radians（弧度）为单位的值的正切。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。
